segments.name: Computing Power and Algorithm Solutions
segments.description: Provides AI compute servers, AI industry application solutions and computing power services to government and enterprise customers.
segments.evidence: Net revenue generated from computing power and algorithm solutions accounted for 83.8% of our total net revenues in fiscal year 2026, which increased by 100% from nil for the fiscal year 2025 to RMB153.7 million (US$22.7 million) for the fiscal year 2026 due to the acquisition of Times Good.

segments.name: Smart Technology and New Energy Solutions
segments.description: Sells mobile charging robots, charging piles and energy storage systems for electric vehicle charging to infrastructure operators.
segments.evidence: Net revenue from Real Prospect Group consists of mobile charging robots and charging piles and convenience charging services.

segments.name: Health And Wellness Products and Services
segments.description: Sells wellness products from natural ingredients, such as bird's nest, ginseng, tea and peptide ingredients.
segments.evidence: This segment generates a relatively small amount of our total revenues from wellness products derived from natural ingredients, including bird's nest products, wild-grown ginseng roots, premium tea, and other natural ingredient products.

revenueModel.text: Public sector entities, infrastructure operators and commercial customers pay for charging, energy and computing solutions, and consumers buy wellness products.
revenueModel.evidence: Our smart technology and new energy solutions business serves a diversified customer base that includes public sector entities, state owned and private infrastructure operators, transportation related service providers, and commercial counterparties involved in electric vehicle charging and energy services.

changes.text: In 2025 the Group divested its wealth management segment and deconsolidated its insurance agency segment.
changes.evidence: Subsequent to the Carve Group acquisition, the Group completed the divestiture of its wealth management segment in September 2025 and the deconsolidation of its insurance agency segment in December 2025.

changes.text: In 2026 a new health and wellness products and services reporting unit and segment was established after the Carve Group acquisition.
changes.evidence: Upon completion of the Carve Group acquisition, a new reporting unit for health and wellness products and services was established as of the acquisition date.
